install:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(pwd)"
if [ ! -d "$ROOT/android-sdk/platform-tools" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$ROOT/android-sdk/cmdline-tools"
  curl -fsSL -o /tmp/cmdline-tools.zip "https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip"
  unzip -q -o /tmp/cmdline-tools.zip -d "$ROOT/android-sdk/cmdline-tools"
  mv "$ROOT/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/cmdline-tools" "$ROOT/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest" 2>/dev/null || true
  export ANDROID_HOME="$ROOT/android-sdk"
  export PATH="$PATH:$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin"
  yes | sdkmanager --licenses >/dev/null
  sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0"
fi
chmod +x gradlew scripts/*.sh
./scripts/build-apk.sh
